Spray Dried Chicory Powder for Coffee Blends, Bakery and Beverages

Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried chicory powder to coffee roasters, beverage brands and bakery manufacturers. As a spray dried chicory powder manufacturer, we turn chicory root extract into a fine, soluble powder with a rich, slightly bitter taste. It mixes easily into a wide range of formulations. It is a popular choice for coffee blends, coffee alternatives and instant beverage mixes.

Advanced Manufacturing Excellence

Chicory roots are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The roots are cleaned, cut and extracted under controlled conditions. The extract is then spray dried, which removes water within seconds. The result is a powder that dissolves readily and has an even particle size of 80-100 mesh. Moisture is kept below 5%, and every batch is checked before packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Versatile Applications and Solutions

Our wholesale spray dried chicory powder is used in several sectors. Coffee companies blend it with coffee or use it to make coffee substitutes. Bakers use it in breads, biscuits and cakes for its deep, bittersweet flavor. Beverage brands add it to instant drink mixes and malt-style drinks. It adds both color and a distinctive bittersweet taste to your products.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

As a spray dried chicory powder exporter, we understand what importers need. We aim to be a long-term supply partner. Our spray dried chicory powder price is set fairly for each volume tier. We ship worldwide from India and offer export documentation support. OEM and private label packing is available to help your brand grow.

Frequently Asked Questions for Buyers

  • What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried chicory powder? The MOQ is 5 Kg. Contact us for a quote based on your volume and packing needs.
  • What certifications and quality standards apply? Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.
  • What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We offer moisture-resistant packing from 1 kg packs to 25 kg bulk bags. Shelf life is 18-24 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place.
  • What are the typical specifications? The standard grade is spray dried, 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5%. Full details are on the specification sheet.
  • What is the lead time and how do I request a sample? Lead time depends on order volume. Samples are available on request through our website contact form.
